treatments.name: SGLT2 inhibitors
treatments.summary: Reduce all-cause mortality, MACE, CKD progression and heart-failure hospitalisation versus usual care.

evidence.quote: Compared with usual care, SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP1 agonists reduce all-cause mortality (high CoE) and major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) (moderate to high CoE)
evidence.statement: SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1 agonists reduce all-cause mortality and major adverse cardiovascular events versus usual care.

evidence.quote: SGLT2 inhibitors reduce progression of chronic kidney disease (CKD) and heart failure hospitalizations
evidence.statement: SGLT2 inhibitors reduce CKD progression and heart-failure hospitalisation.

treatments.name: GLP1 agonists
treatments.summary: Reduce all-cause mortality, MACE and stroke versus usual care.

evidence.quote: Compared with usual care, SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP1 agonists reduce all-cause mortality (high CoE) and major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) (moderate to high CoE)
evidence.statement: SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1 agonists reduce all-cause mortality and major adverse cardiovascular events versus usual care.

treatments.name: DPP4 inhibitors
treatments.summary: Do not reduce all-cause mortality versus usual care; GLP-1 agonists reduce mortality compared with DPP4 inhibitors.

evidence.quote: Compared with usual care, insulin, tirzepatide, and DPP4 inhibitors do not reduce all-cause mortality (low to high CoE).
evidence.statement: Insulin, tirzepatide and DPP-4 inhibitors did not reduce all-cause mortality versus usual care.

evidence.quote: Compared with DPP4 inhibitors, GLP1 agonists reduce all-cause mortality (moderate CoE).
evidence.statement: GLP-1 agonists reduce mortality relative to DPP-4 inhibitors.

treatments.name: Tirzepatide
treatments.summary: Did not reduce all-cause mortality versus usual care in the included trials.

evidence.quote: Compared with usual care, insulin, tirzepatide, and DPP4 inhibitors do not reduce all-cause mortality (low to high CoE).
evidence.statement: Insulin, tirzepatide and DPP-4 inhibitors did not reduce all-cause mortality versus usual care.

treatments.name: Long-acting insulin
treatments.summary: Does not reduce all-cause mortality versus usual care and causes more severe hypoglycemia than SGLT2 inhibitors or GLP1 agonists.

evidence.quote: Compared with usual care, insulin, tirzepatide, and DPP4 inhibitors do not reduce all-cause mortality (low to high CoE).
evidence.statement: Insulin, tirzepatide and DPP-4 inhibitors did not reduce all-cause mortality versus usual care.

evidence.quote: Serious adverse events and severe hypoglycemia are less frequent with SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP1 agonists than with insulin or SU.
evidence.statement: Severe hypoglycemia and serious adverse events are more frequent with insulin or sulfonylureas than with SGLT2 inhibitors or GLP-1 agonists.

treatments.name: Sulfonylureas
treatments.summary: Comparator only: SGLT2 inhibitors reduce MACE versus sulfonylureas, and sulfonylureas cause more severe hypoglycemia.

evidence.quote: Compared with DPP4 inhibitors and sulfonylurea (SU), SGLT2 inhibitors reduce MACE (moderate to high CoE).
evidence.statement: SGLT2 inhibitors reduce major cardiovascular events compared with sulfonylureas.

evidence.quote: Serious adverse events and severe hypoglycemia are less frequent with SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP1 agonists than with insulin or SU.
evidence.statement: Severe hypoglycemia and serious adverse events are more frequent with insulin or sulfonylureas than with SGLT2 inhibitors or GLP-1 agonists.

notes: Systematic review and network meta-analysis commissioned by the American College of Physicians; reports effects, not recommendations.
